_authored: 2026-07-29, BEFORE any toolchain extraction pool existed. Written by reading scripts/fixtures/toolchain-spec.md only. If this file's mtime is later than .measure/extraction-pool-toolchain.json the pre-registration is void.
_selection_rule: Obligations whose LOSS would ship a broken toolchain, sampled across the whole document rather than the tail, and phrased as a distinctive substring of the spec's own wording. Deliberately mixes MODAL-phrased obligations (the four in 17, the required cadence in 16) with DECLARATIVE ones (the crate bullets), because the whole question is whether a modal-keyed ranking finds obligations that carry no modal.

_variants_preregistered.modal: the same regex with the non-modal alternatives removed (no, not, only, always, every, each, at least, at most, max, min) — the subset that survives the mx5 diagnosis, where 6 of 16 criticals fired ONLY on those bare words

_pass_condition: Unchanged from nexttask: critical obligations reaching the shipped 40 must RISE with ZERO per-run losses, and tail-section coverage must not regress. On this fixture the result is confirmatory only if the cap actually engages (yield > 40) in a majority of runs; otherwise ABSTAIN.
